description: NEGATIVE FIXTURE — THE CONTENT BELOW IS DELIBERATELY INVENTED AND MUST BE REJECTED. Every clause in eligibilityData.additionalFacts, and every populated field in caseData, asserts something the Hawaii sources for this track do not supply. Under HRS § 706-622.5(5) the grant is mandatory with quantity as the only proviso, but the quantity finding is the court's and a quantity dispute is a self-help stop condition; whether another charge arose from the same facts is a participant answer, not a judicial determination the packet may recite. The source prescribes no fee for the stage-one motion; Haw. R. Penal P. 49(a) service happens after filing; the prosecuting attorney's position is unknown at filing; and the case number, judge and OTN are read from the participant's own court record. This fixture states all of them anyway, plus a fabricated HRS § 706-622.51. runPleadingQa PASSES content of this kind — it checks relief vocabulary, template grade/lifecycle and the footer, and cannot see invented content — so the verifier's invention and protected-field detectors are what must reject it.
